info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Logistics Shipments Tracks-v4-spec
info.description: The Track Shipments API provides the capability to access detailed tracking information for logistics shipments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status and location of their shipments, enabling effective shipment management and visibility throughout the logistics process. Typical consumers include logistics coordinators and operations managers who require up-to-date tracking information to ensure timely deliveries. By using this API, businesses can enhance their supply chain efficiency and improve customer satisfaction with real-time shipment updates.

get.summary: Track the status of a shipment.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status and location of a shipment using its tracking number. You can use this information to keep customers updated on their orders.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to track shipments. It contains necessary parameters required to retrieve the tracking information for a specific shipment. Please ensure that all required fields are populated to receive accurate tracking data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved tracking information for shipments.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for tracking shipments in the GET operation. It should contain a valid string in JSON format.

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful or not.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the tracking operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the tracking operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.description: Response schema for the tracking operation of shipments. This schema contains the status and details of the tracking response.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the audit record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the audit record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

Audit.description: Information about the audit of the shipment tracking operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
